-- Starts the gw binary inside this app bundle directly, with no Terminal window.
-- GW opens its own window; a file dropped on the app icon is passed as its first argument.
on launchGW(arguments)
	set gwBinary to quoted form of (POSIX path of (path to me) & "Contents/MacOS/gw")
	do shell script "cd \"$HOME\"; " & gwBinary & arguments & " < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &"
end launchGW

on open fileList
	if (count of fileList) is equal to 0 then
		display dialog "No files selected!" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"
	else
		launchGW(" " & quoted form of POSIX path of (item 1 of fileList))
	end if
end open

on run
	-- Opened without a file: GW shows its reference genome chooser
	launchGW("")
end run
